# SKX Labs - Full Technical Specification & Methodology

## About SKX Labs
SKX Labs specializes in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). The agency converts legacy websites into machine-readable knowledge graphs optimized for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models, including ChatGPT Search, Perplexity.ai, Google AI Overviews, and Microsoft Copilot.

## Core Technical Standards
1. **BLUF (Bottom Line Up Front):** Immediate 40–80 word direct answer blocks at the beginning of content sections.
2. **Triple-Schema Integration:** Nested Schema.org JSON-LD arrays linking `Organization`, `Person`, and `Service` nodes via unique `@id` anchors.
3. **Multi-Model Citation Optimization:** Formatting statistics (+37% citation lift) and authoritative citations (+40% citation lift) to align with LLM ranking weights.
